subject.title: [Feature]: Per-session activity state (busy/idle + awaiting_user, awaiting_subagent) via gateway API + WS statechange

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class `sessions.activity` Gateway RPC/WS contract with explicit attention and child-rollup semantics, or keep status visibility as `sessions.list` and UI-specific projections?
rationale: The request is valid but it adds a new public protocol contract across Gateway, sessions, agents, and clients; automation should not choose the long-term API shape from the open overlapping PRs.

options.title: Define canonical activity contract
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical spec, ask an owner to choose the minimal payload and event semantics, then review or replace the open PRs against that contract.

options.title: Narrow to UI/list projections
options.body: Decline the dedicated RPC/WS surface for now and only accept smaller `sessions.list` or Control UI status improvements.

options.title: Defer core protocol work
options.body: Leave the issue open but block implementation until the dashboard or multi-agent roadmap explicitly sponsors the protocol surface.

recommendation.title: Define canonical activity contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical spec, ask an owner to choose the minimal payload and event semantics, then review or replace the open PRs against that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the current assignee and best available owner for deciding whether this should become a stable Gateway protocol contract.
